items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of doubled subsidy
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The Widerspruch period is one month from 'Bekanntgabe' (notification) of the decision, per §84 SGG / §37 SGB X. Bekanntgabe for a letter sent by ordinary post by a German social-insurance body is deemed to occur on the 4th day after posting (for items posted since 2025), from which the one-month period under §§187, 188 BGB would run, ending on the same-numbered day of the following month (shifted to the next business day in NW if that day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday). However, the letter itself carries no printed document date (no 'Datum' field is visible on the page), so there is no day to count the 4-day deemed-delivery period from. Without a known posting/document date, the start of the period — and therefore the exact due date — cannot be determined.

warnings: The letter has no printed document date (Datum), so the one-month Widerspruch deadline cannot be computed exactly; the person should check the envelope postmark or ask the Krankenkasse for the date the decision was sent, then count one month from the deemed delivery (4 days after posting) from that date.

The IBAN shown (DE34 2005 0550 0003 0006 00) is only the sender's own account information printed in the footer, not a payment demand in this letter; there is no payment instruction to verify against it here.
